claims.claim: Infleqtion reported Q2 2026 revenue of $12.6M, up 116% year over year, raised 2026 revenue outlook to about $43M, and ended Q2 with $582M of cash/restricted cash/securities and no debt.

On September 14, 2026 Infleqtion disclosed a CUDA-Q Logical/qLDPC integration that used about six physical data qubits per logical qubit in its tested construction, while extending work toward physical execution and decoder benchmarking.

risks.risk: Revenue remains small and quantum roadmaps remain technically uncertain despite strong liquidity and growth.

contradictions.contradiction: Commercialization metrics are improving quickly, but utility-scale fault-tolerant execution is still a forward technical objective.

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration, gross margin and cash-burn durability require Alpha underwriting.

claims.claim: Infleqtion says it remains on track for 30 logical qubits in 2026 and has linked the roadmap to actual government/commercial revenue rather than research milestones alone.
Its September Cisco collaboration and NVIDIA integration widen the execution surface from standalone quantum systems into networked and hybrid accelerated-computing workflows.

risks.risk: Partner integrations can remain demonstrations rather than scalable revenue unless customer deployments follow.

unknowns.unknown: Independent verification of the 30-logical-qubit 2026 milestone and economics of Sqale deployments remain open.
